slog3.evidence: measured camera output; default non-negative clamp and the current hue table
slog3.reference: One preceding same-scene N-RAW; REDline 65.2.1, inverse fixed saturation processing, conversion to S-Gamut3.Cine / S-Log3
slog3.normalization: No per-patch or per-channel colour fit. CIELAB uses reference white-patch luminance and D65.

log3g10.evidence: offline forward-model prediction using the current integer matrix and hue table
log3g10.reference: Same-scene N-RAW decoded to linear RWG, fixed saturation processing inverted pixelwise before ROI means
log3g10.normalization: Each condition: geometric-mean match of three neutral patches, independently for R/G/B. This removes exposure and white-balance offsets; no per-colour fit at scoring time.
log3g10.model_input: Sensor-relative linear estimate from measured video, with the previously recorded hue table inverted by the measured 32-node model; not a sensor-register readback.
